recipes.title: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.description: Yoghurt-marinated chicken, charred under the grill and simmered in a creamy spiced tomato sauce.

lines.note: boneless and skinless, cut into bite-sized pieces
depending on how hot you like it

steps: Mix the yoghurt, garam masala, turmeric, garlic, lemon juice and a good pinch of salt in a bowl. Stir in the chicken, cover and leave in the fridge for at least an hour.
Heat the grill to high. Spread the chicken on a lined tray, shaking off any extra marinade, and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Fry the onion for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and golden, then add the green chilli and ginger and cook for a minute more.
Stir in the garam masala, cumin, paprika and chilli powder and cook for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Stir in the cream and the grilled chicken and simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste and scatter over the coriander to serve.

recipes.title: Oat and raisin cookies
recipes.description: Chewy cookies with crisp edges, made with porridge oats and plenty of raisins.
steps: Beat the butter and sugar with a hand mixer until pale and fluffy, then beat in the golden syrup.
Stir in the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cinnamon (if using) and salt, then the oats and raisins, until the dough comes together.
Cover the bowl and chill the dough for 30 minutes, so the cookies hold their shape in the oven.
Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two baking trays. Roll the dough into 16 balls and space them well apart on the trays, flattening each one slightly.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle. Leave on the trays for 5 minutes, then move to a rack to cool.

recipes.title: Spaghetti aglio e olio
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed in olive oil with gently fried garlic and chilli: dinner from the store cupboard in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in a large pan of well-salted boiling water for a minute less than the packet says. Keep a mugful of the cooking water before you drain it.

While the pasta cooks, warm the oil in a large frying pan over a low heat. Add the garlic and chilli flakes and cook gently for 3 to 4 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold. Don't let it brown, or it turns bitter.
Tip the drained spaghetti into the frying pan with a splash of the cooking water and toss for a minute until every strand is glossy, adding more water if it looks dry.
Toss through the parsley, season with salt and serve with the parmesan, if using.

recipes.title: Greek salad
recipes.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, olives and a whole slab of feta, dressed with olive oil and oregano.
steps: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper and olives in a wide bowl.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and half the oregano with a little salt and pepper, then pour it over the vegetables and toss gently.
Lay the feta on top in one piece, sprinkle over the rest of the oregano and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Spanish tortilla
recipes.description: A thick potato and onion omelette, cooked slowly in olive oil and good warm or cold.
steps: Heat the oil in a 24 cm non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat. Add the potatoes and onion and cook gently for 25 to 30 minutes, turning now and then, until soft but not browned.
Beat the eggs with the salt in a large bowl. Lift the potatoes and onion out of the pan with a slotted spoon, leaving the oil behind, and stir them into the eggs. Leave for 5 minutes.

Pour all but a tablespoon of the oil out of the pan (keep it for another day) and put the pan back over a medium heat. Tip in the egg mixture and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, until set underneath but still a little loose on top.
Put a large plate over the pan and turn it over in one confident movement, then slide the tortilla back into the pan, cooked side up. Cook for 3 minutes more.
Slide the tortilla onto a board and leave it to rest for 10 minutes before cutting it into wedges.
